Messages.Author: direwolf
Messages.Body:
"Hell's Satans"

Mortal gang.
If this gang is successfully recruited, you may equip a Hawg or Sports Bike for each mortal ally you control (including this one) from your hand, ash heap or library (pay cost as normal). If this ally does not have a Hawg or Sports Bike, burn him.

WoD reference: the Brujah have other mortal gangs to recruit, why not expand?

Other reference: "Hell's Satans" is from the Simpsons. lol.

Game Need: A fun card that interacts with other allies with the opportunity to thin your deck.

Independent Futurist. Contrarian (titled, X votes where X is the number of votes as the acting minion.) Target Vitals is always the better combat card.

Messages.Author: 2wayspeaker
Messages.Body: I like this and I think it's a very balanced effect
